note: Offline diagnostic processing only. No model execution, no Docker, no GPU. Synthetic-defect ground truth (pytest oracle runs) is separate and reported below.

diagnostic_only.method: 1 cold run + 5 warm runs per case; time.perf_counter(); tracemalloc peak during cold run

separated_costs.evidence_ingestion: dominant share of each case (trajectory + patch file reads); measured jointly with attribution here
separated_costs.attribution_and_reporting: the V3.3-added logic; previously measured at ~6 ms/record on the frozen cohort
separated_costs.independent_oracle_execution: pytest/Go/Node ground-truth runs (see below); NOT part of diagnostic latency

ground_truth_oracle_cost.note: building ground truth is separate from running the engine
ground_truth_oracle_cost.pytest_oracle_runs: 13 domains x (1 correct + 1-2 mutants), each a sub-second local pytest invocation

caveats: 30 warm samples total; per-case n=5. Quantiles are observed sample values, not population estimates.
Windows timing granularity is coarse; small cases round to a few ms.
These figures do not cover model execution or V3.2 oracle execution, which are not part of offline diagnosis.
